subject: Post-call: Security sprint — SOC 2, audit logs & evidence plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@keystonepayments.com>, secops@keystonepayments.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Security sprint — SOC 2, audit logs & evidence plan

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view. I captured the items your team prioritized during the call and the initial evidence requests so Procurement / SecOps can progress.

Pain points / goals you described
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a summary of controls mapped to data flows (primary ask).
- Audit log access: want sustained retention for 12 months, ability to export logs, and tamper-evident delivery for third-party audit.
- DPA wording: limited retention & deletion commitments, right to audit, subprocessor list.
- Pen test evidence: recent red-team/pen tests and whether remediation tracking is public.
- Low-latency fallbacks and predictable throughput for production payment workloads (business/ops ask).

What we committed to deliver by next touch (target: 48–72 hrs)
1) Compliance pack (SOC 2 summary, control mappings, pen test high-level findings) — attached: redwood-compliance-pack-v1.pdf and SOC2-TypeII-summary-2026.pdf.
2) Sample audit log export (7-day slice) and schema + guidance for 12-month retention export — attached: audits-log-sample-7days.jsonl.
3) DPA checklist & suggested contract language for retention and audit rights (sending to Legal for mark-up, will share suggested redlines).
4) Timeline proposal for evidence handoff and an Ops deep-dive (suggest Wed 2027-04-28 09:00 PT).

Open clarifying questions (please confirm on reply)
- Is the 12-month retention requirement a hard requirement for go-live, or acceptable as an initial 6-month window with roadmap to 12 months?
- Who will be our primary SecOps contact for log-format questions (you suggested Tom, confirming)?
- Does Procurement require a full pen-test report or is a summary + remediation tracker acceptable for initial security review?

Next steps / asks for Keystone
- Confirm whether Wednesday 09:00 PT works for the technical deep-dive (we'll include an infra engineer + product).
- Share any specific DPA clauses Procurement wants prioritized.

Thanks — attaching the initial pack now. If useful I can also provide a read-only S3 bucket with daily audit exports, or set up an ad-hoc log delivery during the call.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-compliance-pack-v1.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB)
Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-summary-2026.pdf (pdf, 520KB)
Attachment: audits-log-sample-7days.jsonl (jsonl, 48KB)
From: Tom Ellis <secops@keystonepayments.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@keystonepayments.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security sprint — SOC 2, audit logs & evidence plan

Laura —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Initial read through the pack looks good; a few notes from SecOps:
- SOC 2 summary is helpful; we'll need the full Type II report for our audit team before legal signs off. If full report is redacted, we need a way to validate controls (e.g., auditor contact or SOC 2 bridge letter).
- Audit logs: format looks fine. We require an integrity check (SHA256 manifest) and export endpoint that supports 30-day retention for indexed queries, but stored copies must be held 12 months for compliance.
- Pen test: summary is okay for the initial review, but our risk team will request the full report under NDA. Can Redwood provide a recent remediation tracker or a summary of open/closed findings with dates?

For the first deep-dive, Wed 09:00 PT works for us. I'll invite our infra lead (infra.lead@keystonepayments.com).

One procurement note: we may ask for a temporary SLA credit clause for the pilot period; I will loop vendor_ops on the follow-up thread.

Tom
SecOps Manager, Keystone Payments

Rishi / Marissa — FYI and quick internal notes from the call with Keystone (Tom + Alice):

What they want urgently
- Full SOC 2 Type II report or auditor contact / bridge letter (Procurement will not greenlight without this).
- Audit log retention 12 months, exportable with integrity manifest (they accept query layer for 30-day, but copies must be retained 12 months).
- Pen test full report under NDA; summary + remediation tracker OK for initial review.
- Procurement asking about temporary SLA credit for pilot.

Suggested internal owners
- Rishi: can you coordinate with Infosec to pull the full SOC 2 report and draft a bridge-letter option? Also confirm whether we can provide an auditor contact under existing agreements.
- Marissa: can you coordinate with Legal on DPA wording for retention & audit rights and the pilot SLA credit ask?

I'll own the tech demo & log export config + scheduling the Wed 09:00 PT deep-dive.

Let me know if you want me to soften any language in the external follow-up.

Laura

Laura / Team —

Thanks — Wed 09:00 PT confirmed and vendor_ops is looped for contract items. A few follow-ups before the meeting:
- Please bring a sample manifest showing the SHA256 checksums for the audit exports.
- If you can provide a redacted full SOC 2 report ahead of the meeting (or a bridge letter that explains what was tested), Procurement will expedite review.
- On pen-test: our legal team prefers the remediation tracker exported as CSV with severity and closure date; that will speed approval.

We look forward to the deep-dive. If you can share the S3 read-only option for the sample logs before Wed, that would be helpful for our infra lead to pre-check the schema.

Best,

Alice Morgan
Senior Product Ops, Keystone Payments
